FORM NO. 3
G. 65M-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
C.B.C, Special Branch. STATION
REPORT
Date. May 16 D. 1939
Subject (in full).........CHUNAKOFF, Tamara - Departure of Date......

Made by...J.S. Pharazyn...........Forwarded by...........Inspector E. Kaye

Miss T. CHUMAKOVA, age 25, artiste,
Russian, left Shanghai for Tsingtao by the s.s. "Tsingtao
Maru" on 10-5-39.

This person is believed to be identical
with Miss Tamara CHUNAKOFF, alias Tamara CHUMAKOVA, on
record in this office as being an associate of Dick
Norton, alias Dick Goatcher, British, noted for observa-
tion as living on his wits while travelling with a troupe
of entertainers throughout the Orient in 1934.

Tamara Chunakoff is mentioned as having
been associated with Norton as a dancer.

FILE
D. S.
D.C. (Special Branch).
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

报告
日期. 1939年5月16日 D. 
主题（全称）.........CHUNAKOFF, Tamara - 离境 日期......

制作人...J.S. Pharazyn...........转呈人...........督察 E. Kaye

塔玛拉·丘马科娃小姐（Miss T. CHUMAKOVA），25岁，艺人，
俄国人，于1939年5月10日乘“青岛丸”号轮船（s.s. "Tsingtao
Maru"）离开上海前往青岛。

据信此人与本处档案中记录的塔玛拉·丘纳科夫小姐（Miss Tamara CHUNAKOFF），又名塔玛拉·丘马科娃（Tamara CHUMAKOVA），为同一人。档案记载她是迪克·诺顿（Dick Norton），又名迪克·戈彻（Dick Goatcher），英国人的 associates。该英国人因在1934年随一个演艺团体游历东方各地时靠小聪明谋生而受到关注。

塔玛拉·丘纳科夫被提及曾作为舞者与诺顿有关联。

存档
D. S.
副总监（特别分部）。
